title: Editing: Scared by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

John Lennon’s song ‘Scared’ was completed for the Walls And Bridges on 30 August 1974.

The final touch was the sound of a wolf howling, which was used to open the song. The recording was edited in from The Language And Music Of The Wolves, a 1971 documentary album narrated by actor Robert Redford. Lennon had previously sampled the album in 1972 while producing Elephant’s Memory’s second album.

A compilation reel of the final mixes for the album was also created during this session. This was the final session for Walls And Bridges, although it was mixed in quadrophonic sound in September 1974.
